summary.title: OWASP-THREAT-MODEL
summary.description: A small wireless LAN consisting of one router/access point connected to an ISP, several client devices (laptops and smartphones), a shared printer, and an IoT device. Users connect over Wi-Fi using a pre-shared key, with a separate guest/IoT segment. This model identifies the assets, threats and vulnerabilities of the WLAN using the STRIDE method and proposes controls to reduce risk.
